name: Quinn Playground Center
operator_name: Town of Dartmouth Parks & Recreation Department
description_short: A town-run summer day program for children ages 6 to 12, focused on open play, arts and crafts, group games and outdoor recreation. It runs 8:30 am to 4:15 pm, with before and after care available, and takes up to 55 children per week.

warnings: Old season: the source is a town news release posted March 25, 2026, about the 2026 summer, which has already ended (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information is given.

The source is a town news release covering many Parks & Recreation programs, not a page for this camp alone. Other programs are not recorded here: tennis for kids & teens ages 7-14 ($225 per session, June 29-Aug 6), Junior Tennis Team ages 10-18 ($250), musical theatre workshops ages 5-12 (July 6-10 and July 20-24, $185 each, at 1383 Tucker Rd), pickleball, and adult tennis.

The weekly session breakdown is worked out from the stated range 'June 29-August 21, 2026' and the per-week pricing and capacity. The source does not list individual weeks or say whether any holidays are closed (for example July 3).
The before and after care fee of '$40 per child' does not say whether it is per week, per day or per summer.
The town address (400 Slocum Road) on the page is Town Hall, not necessarily where the program meets, so it is not recorded as the camp address.
